Messages.Author: Khaleph Alendis
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Some question were posted on our mailling list and we would like
official answer.

1)If i have a vampire of capacity 1 can i play Govern the Unaligned on
him ?

My answer would be yes, the blood not needed will simply be lost for
the meth. It's right ?

2) Tremere Convocation said : «Vampires with basic Thaumaturgy may play
combat cards requiring Thaumaturgy as if they had superior Thaumaturgy.»

Is it only for the vampire of the player of the Tremere Convocation
card or that apply for all the players vampire at the table ?

3) Can someone play multiple combat card like Drawing Out the Beast
befor range is chosen ?
Exemple : A player play 5 Drawing Out the Beast at superior and the
oposing minion take 5 damages not preventable ?

4) Constanza Vinti (POT and CEL) is in combat. Can this situation
happen :

Befor range, he play
Torn Signpost (set base damage at 3)
Increased Strength (+2 damage on all strikes requiring Potence)

The range is set to close.

The vampire play Pushing the Limit (+3 damage)
So he does 8 damages to the opposing minion.

He play Blur for 2 additional strikes.

First additional : Undead Strength (+2 damages)
Second additional : Mighty Grapple (+1 damages)

So, it's another 7 damages.

It's all right ?

And can he had play before range Fire in the Blood in conjonction with
Increased Strength ?

Thank's,

--
Khaleph Alendis, High Priest of Maizerets
VEKN Setite Prince of Beauport
http://cdd.citeweb.net/khaleph/

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Khaleph Alendis wrote:
>
> Hello,
>
> Some question were posted on our mailling list and we would like
> official answer.
>
> 1)If i have a vampire of capacity 1 can i play Govern the Unaligned on
> him ?

Any vampire with superior dominate (and a capacity above 1) could play
superior GtU to move 3 blood to the 1-cap in your uncontrolled region, yes.

> My answer would be yes, the blood not needed will simply be lost for
> the meth. It's right ?

The blood is not lost until the vampire enters the Ready Region, at
which time excess blood drains off (as it always does). You'd still have
some time in your influence phase to use your transfers to move some of
that blood to your Pool before he enters the Ready Region.

> 2) Tremere Convocation said : «Vampires with basic Thaumaturgy may play
> combat cards requiring Thaumaturgy as if they had superior Thaumaturgy.»
>
> Is it only for the vampire of the player of the Tremere Convocation
> card or that apply for all the players vampire at the table ?

All vampires, since the cards doesn't restrict the effect to "your" vampires.
Similarly, all Tremere at the table get +1 stealth when taking Thaumaturgy
actions.

> 3) Can someone play multiple combat card like Drawing Out the Beast
> befor range is chosen ?
> Exemple : A player play 5 Drawing Out the Beast at superior and the
> oposing minion take 5 damages not preventable ?

Yes.

> 4) Constanza Vinti (POT and CEL) is in combat. Can this situation
> happen :
>
> Befor range, he play
> Torn Signpost (set base damage at 3)
> Increased Strength (+2 damage on all strikes requiring Potence)
>
> The range is set to close.
>
> The vampire play Pushing the Limit (+3 damage)
> So he does 8 damages to the opposing minion.
>
> He play Blur for 2 additional strikes.
>
> First additional : Undead Strength (+2 damages)
> Second additional : Mighty Grapple (+1 damages)
>
> So, it's another 7 damages.

... for the Undead Strength strike and another 6 for the Mighty Grapple.

> It's all right ?

Assuming that neither of the first two strikes resulted in the burning or
torporization of the opposing minion, yes. (Well, Constanza's a "she",
but otherwise right).

> And can he had play before range Fire in the Blood in conjonction with
> Increased Strength ?

Yes. They are not mutually exclusive.

--
